synth.notes:
Block mode: 1/2 move both blocks up/down 4px; 3/4 move block_left left/right and block_right mirrored. Guard: a block cannot enter a cell overlapping a marker or leave the board.
Clicking a marker switches to player mode (blocks become color_1 armed players, clicked marker active/11). In player mode 1-4 move the active marker, clicking a marker selects it, clicking a player switches back to block mode (all markers inactive).
Step bar: two color-0 walls whose width is ceil(3n/7); the first action after level start is not counted. The counter is gated on bar continuity, and it falls back to the smallest n that matches the width. Names are type_color_rank by (y,x), with block_* taking indices 0 and 1.
The 5 failures (t3-5: left block stuck going up at (14,42); t11/t18: marker stuck at (11,19) going left and at (35,15) going right) look like invisible maze walls inside the wall_15/hazard_8 bounding boxes. The schema has no pixels for those, so they cannot be modelled.
